## Administrations

```{r echo=FALSE}
grViz("
digraph surveillance_diagram {

  graph [
    layout = dot,
    rankdir = TB,
    fontsize = 10
  ]
  
  node [
    shape = rectangle,
    #fixedsize = true,
    width = 2
  ]
  
  EX [label = \"EX domain\"]
  admin_pre_expansion [shape = none, label = \"admin_pre_expansion()\"]
  expand [label = \"treatment episode\nexpansion\"]
  admin_post_expansion [shape = none, label = \"admin_post_expansion()\"]
  carry_forward [label = \"carry forward\nadministration times\"]

  EX -> admin_pre_expansion
  admin_pre_expansion  -> expand
  expand -> admin_post_expansion
  admin_post_expansion -> carry_forward
}
")
```

## Observations

```{r echo=FALSE}
grViz("
digraph surveillance_diagram {

  graph [
    layout = dot,
    rankdir = TB,
    fontsize = 10
  ]
  
  node [
    shape = rectangle,
    #fixedsize = true,
    width = 2
  ]
  
  domain [label = \"XX domain\"]
  coding_table [label = \"apply coding table\n(if applicable)\"]
  obs_filter [label = \"apply observation filter\n(if applicable)\"]
  cat_filter [label = \"apply cat/scat filters\n(if applicable)\"]
  obs_raw [shape = none, label = \"obs_raw()\"]
  merge [label = \"merge observations\ninto nif object\"]
  times [label = \"update TIME, TAD,\nTAFD fields\"]
  obs_final [shape = none, label = \"obs_final()\"]
  
  domain -> coding_table
  coding_table -> obs_filter
  obs_filter -> cat_filter
  cat_filter -> obs_raw
  obs_raw -> merge
  merge -> times
  times -> obs_final
}
")
```
